Diagnosis

Digital design begins with the decision path.

The question is not only what screen to design. The question is what a customer needs to understand before they can move forward.

Signal Diagnosis Design Response

Visitors understand the offer too slowly

The site is presenting information in the wrong order.

Rebuild the information architecture around the customer decision.

Users drop from key product flows

Interface friction is hiding the next useful action.

Clarify states, feedback, hierarchy, and task sequence.

Teams keep redesigning pages ad hoc

There is no shared digital system for recurring decisions.

Create reusable patterns, content rules, and handoff documentation.
